title: GovRamp Cyber Summit 2026
summary: We are excited to announce that eFax® will be attending the upcoming GovRAMP Cyber Summit! As government and public health leaders work to modernize legacy systems, mitigating cyber risk, maintaining data privacy, and upholding operational continuity are essential to mission success. For federal agencies—as well as state and municipal organizations requiring federal-level security—we offer ECFax®, our FedRAMP® Class D (High) Certified solution purpose-built to satisfy rigorous federal security controls, streamline procurement, and advance mission outcomes. body_markdown:
We are excited to announce that eFax® will be attending the upcoming GovRAMP Cyber Summit! As government and public health leaders work to modernize legacy systems, mitigating cyber risk, maintaining data privacy, and upholding operational continuity are essential to mission success. For federal agencies—as well as state and municipal organizations requiring federal-level security—we offer ECFax®, our FedRAMP® Class D (High) Certified solution purpose-built to satisfy rigorous federal security controls, streamline procurement, and advance mission outcomes. Alongside ECFax, we also offer eFax Corporate®, backed by AES 256-bit encryption and HITRUST r2 certified infrastructure to advance health equity and patient safety through secure, transparent data exchange while fulfilling strict regulatory standards, including HIPAA, HITECH, and GLBA.


Transitioning from analog hardware to a cloud fax platform allows agencies to accelerate secure modernization while significantly lowering operational costs and IT overhead. By eliminating physical fax machines and manual maintenance, eFax® streamlines critical workflows and empowers distributed teams to safely access, sign, and transmit sensitive records from anywhere. Our team will be on-site throughout the summit and looks forward to connecting with public sector leaders to discuss how our certified platforms can simplify your agency’s path to secure, compliant digital transformation.


[Learn More](https://govramp.org/events/2026-cyber-summit)
